label: early copy steps (outputs 1-2) of long (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or the <DEL> step. Concentrated on the 2nd and 3rd copy outputs (recall_idx 1-2, i.e. t=10-11; recall_idx 2 alone holds 72% of mass) of the longest sequences (L=9 holds 89% of mass, L=8 11%, none for L<=6). Strongest at recall_idx 2 (input two steps after <DEL>). Within this window it is sparse (precision ~0.29): whether it fires depends on token identity (inputs s, r, x, 3, f, v, a are favored; more digits in the sequence raise the rate), but no simple token rule clearly improves on the position rule. Small tail at the last copy steps of L=9. L>=8 with recall_idx 1-3 covers 99% of mass at precision 0.13.
